_comment: The board key this site publishes, written by publish-live-board.py. This is an OBSERVATION of what the shipped client posts to, not a choice made here. check-board-liveness.py reads it to decide whether a populated board is 'deployed' or an orphan. Kept separate from weekly/current.json because weekly-league-manager.py owns that file and rewrites it on rollover.
epoch_source: pdoom1 via pdoom1-website issue #151 comment 2026-07-28T23:13 ('the live epoch on Friday is L3'), restated on issue #201 comment 2026-07-30T02:44 ('Board key: L3. Not v0.13.2, not L3.0, not a build version'). Game-side authority: GameConfig.get_board_version() returns 'L' + LADDER_VERSION, ladder_version.txt = 3.

seed_provenance.derivation: observed live on the score API; the board the client is posting to
seed_provenance.note: Not a blessing. Friday's competitive seed is drawn at the ceremony and recorded in docs/LEAGUE_SEED_LEDGER.md. This file records what IS, so that the site publishes the board players actually reach.
